Evan (RevOps): Heads up — Alder Labs (acct AL-998) got a co-sell partner rebate applied incorrectly to their April invoice. Invoice 90112 shows a $12k partner rebate but contract only entitles them to $5k. 

billing-bot: Auto-audit: invoice=90112 rebate_mismatch detected. Suggested remediation: (A) issue manual refund for $7k, tag as 'partner rebate correction', and create revenue reversal entry; or (B) contact partner to confirm approval before refund.

Marta (Account Manager): We spoke with Alder and partner. Partner says the extra $7k came from an internal promo that was not approved for co-sell deals. Partner requests we hold refund until they confirm. Customer is pressing for resolution - they escalated to the CSM.

Liam (Revenue): For GAAP we need documentation before reversing revenue. If partner must approve, we can create a pending credit memo and put the amount on hold. Need signoff from Legal if we proceed without partner OK. 

Nadia (Billing): I can draft a credit memo: `CM-90112-01` for $7,000 pending partner approval. Workflow: create memo, set status = pending_partner_approval, do not post revenue reversal until signed confirmation. Anyone object?

Julio (Legal): No objection to pending memo. Recommend we include a short addendum to the partner agreement confirming the promo was misapplied and that they authorize the refund. I'll prepare a one-paragraph acknowledgement to attach. Also flag for precedence - this should not be a recurring tolerance.

Evan (RevOps): OK proceed with pending memo. Nadia, please also add a note to close loop with Pricing so promo rules exclude co-sell deals. Create ticket in BO: #BO-1478 and set priority P2. 

Nadia (Billing): Done. Created credit memo CM-90112-01 (amount $7,000) status=pending_partner_approval. BO-1478 created and linked. Added ledger note: "Partner rebate correction - Alder Labs - do not post revenue reversal until partner confirmation". cc @Liam.

Marta (Account Manager): I'll nudge the partner legal contact and loop Julio. ETA for partner reply ~48 hrs. I'll update thread with their confirmation or rejection.

Evan (RevOps): Thanks. If we don't get partner signoff in 7 business days, we'll escalate to CRO for a decision on booking reversal. Marking this resolved for finance ops for now. :white_check_mark:
